title: Adaptive Vendor Onboarding: Evidence-First Flow with Conditional Insurance Offramp
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce procurement friction and time-to-contract for mid-market vendors by shifting to an evidence-first onboarding flow that surfaces SOC2 artifacts, automates insurance offset recommendations, and provides a clear 'offramp' path when vendors can't immediately meet requirements.

Scope:
- Build a conditional onboarding flow in vendor portal that accepts partial SOC2 evidence and maps it to risk buckets.
- Surface insurance-credit recommendations (pricing offsets) when gaps exist, with templated contract clauses.
- Add UI for procurement reviewers to accept mitigations, request follow-ups, or offer temporary limited access contracts.

Success metrics:
- 30% reduction in average time from vendor invite to signed contract for mid-market segment.
- 40% decrease in manual evidence collection time for procurement teams.
- >50% of borderline vendors convert via insurance-credit path instead of being escalated to legal.

Out of scope:
- Full SOC2 attestation automation (future epic).
- Integration with external insurance underwriters (pilot only).
acceptance_criteria: Vendor portal shows step-by-step evidence collection and marks required vs optional artifacts
Procurement team can issue an insurance-credit offer template from portal and record decision in audit log
Risk buckets are populated based on provided evidence and mapped to contract SLO templates
End-to-end flow includes audit log entries, email notifications, and dashboard metrics for conversion rate
